en: That the company failed to meet its targets has been widely reported.
tr: Şirketin hedeflerine ulaşamadığı geniş çapta rapor edildi.
ipa: /ðæt ðə ˈkʌmpəni feɪld tə miːt ɪts ˈtɑːɡɪts həz biːn ˈwaɪdli rɪˈpɔːtɪd/
trPron: Dät dı kampıni feyld tı miit its targıts häz biin waydli ripotıd
collocations: has been widely reported, that-clause as subject, complex passive
synonyms: has been documented, has been stated
antonyms: has been ignored, has been overlooked
commonMistake: It has been widely reported that the company failed to meet its targets. (more natural)
aiExplain: 'That' clause cümlenin öznesi olabilir, ancak bu yapı ağırdır ve nadir tercih edilir. 'That the company failed... has been reported' = 'Şirketin başarısız olduğu rapor edildi'. Daha doğal olan 'It has been reported that...' yapısıdır. Akademik yazıda bazen tercih edilir, ancak çok resmi ve ağırdır.

en: He was heard say that he would resign.
ipa: /hiː wəz hɜːd seɪ ðæt hiː wʊd rɪˈzaɪn/
trPron: Hi vöz höd sey det hi vud rizayn
collocations: was heard say, passive with perception verb, bare infinitive
commonMistake: He was heard to say that he would resign. (also correct, with 'to')
aiExplain: 'See, hear, watch, feel, notice' gibi algı fiilleri (verbs of perception) edilgen yapıda 'to' alabilir veya almayabilir. 'He was heard say that' = 'Söylerken duyuldu'. 'He was heard TO say that' da doğrudur, ancak 'to' daha resmidir. Aktif cümlede 'I heard him say' (to'suz). Gazetelerde, dedikodu raporlarında ve resmi ifadelerde kullanılır.

en: The team was disappointed to learn that they had been eliminated.
tr: Takım elendiklerini öğrenince hayal kırıklığına uğradı.
ipa: /ðə tiːm wəz ˌdɪsəˈpɔɪntɪd tə lɜːn ðæt ðeɪ həd biːn ɪˈlɪmɪneɪtɪd/
trPron: Dı tiim vöz disöpoyntid tı lörn det dey häd biin ilimineytid
collocations: was disappointed to learn, emotion passive, reaction
synonyms: was saddened to find out, was disheartened to discover
antonyms: was pleased to learn, was happy to hear
commonMistake: It disappointed the team that they had been eliminated. (active, less formal)
aiExplain: 'Disappointed, surprised, shocked, pleased, delighted' gibi duygu sıfatları passsive infinitive ile kullanılabilir. 'The team was disappointed to learn' = 'Takım öğrenince hayal kırıklığına uğradı'. Bu yapı, bir olayın duygusal tepkisini vurgular. Spor haberlerinde, iş değerlendirmelerinde ve kişisel anlatılarda kullanılır.

en: The CEO had the contract reviewed by the legal team.
ipa: /ðə ˌsiː iː ˈəʊ hæd ðə ˈkɒntrækt rɪˈvjuːd baɪ ðə ˈliːɡəl tiːm/
trPron: Dı si i ou häd dı kontrakt rivyuud bay dı liigıl tiim
collocations: had the contract reviewed, formal causative, passive arrangement
synonyms: arranged for the contract to be reviewed, caused the contract to be reviewed
antonyms: did not have reviewed, neglected to have reviewed
commonMistake: The CEO got the contract reviewed by the legal team. (less formal)
aiExplain: 'Have something done' (causative passive) bir işin başkası tarafından yapılmasını ifade eder. 'Had the contract reviewed' = 'Sözleşmeyi inceltti'. 'Get something done' daha informaldir. İş İngilizcesinde, ofis yönetiminde ve resmi düzenlemelerde kullanılır. Özne (CEO) işi YAPTIRAN kişidir, yapan değil.

en: The roof needs repairing. (The roof needs to be repaired.)
collocations: needs repairing, need + gerund, passive meaning
synonyms: requires repair, needs to be fixed
antonyms: is in good condition, doesn't need repair
commonMistake: The roof needs to be repaired. (clearer but longer)
aiExplain: 'Need + V-ing' (gerund) yapısı edilgen anlam taşır. 'The roof needs repairing' = 'The roof needs TO BE REPAIRED'. 'Your hair needs cutting' = 'Your hair needs to be cut'. Bu yapı günlük konuşmada ve resmi olmayan yazıda 'to be' li yapıya tercih edilir. 'Want' ile de kullanılır: 'The car wants cleaning' (arabanın temizlenmesi gerek).
